name: Multi-language Webshell dataset
description: This dataset contains a collection of benign and malicious webshells. The source of these webshells are mainly collected from Github and open source projects. It is made available for replication of our ongoing work on the automatic detection of webshells. The list of webshells is filtered using MD5 for all languages and VLD for PHP language.
